dataset_id.identifier: The project metadata and tabular experimental data will be deposited in BioStudies. Associated image data, metadata, analysis scripts, and supporting documentation will be deposited in the same repository or linked repository records where applicable. Associated data will be linked to the resulting scientific publication where applicable. The deposited dataset may also be described in a dedicated data article or data descriptor after completion of the study, particularly for the image-based individual-identification dataset and associated growth-performance records. Such a data article would provide a structured description of the dataset, metadata, image-processing workflow, quality-control procedures, and reuse potential, and would link directly to the repository accession and associated scientific publication.

format:
The project will generate the following data types:
Tabular experimental data, including individual fish body weight, total length, mortality records, treatment information, and tank-level biomass at each sampling occasion, stored in CSV format. Individual measurement records will link each fish to its virtual identity tag, replicate tank, treatment group, sampling date, and sampling occasion. Tank biomass will be recorded or calculated for each tank at each sampling occasion to support growth-performance.
Calculated growth performance data will be stored in CSV format and will include parameters such as weight gain (WG), specific growth rate (SGR), condition factor (K), and survival rate.
Digital image data will include original images of individual fish collected at each sampling point and processed region-of-interest images generated from a standardized image-processing workflow. Images will be stored in JPEG format and linked to project metadata describing the virtual fish identity, replicate tank, treatment group, sampling date and time, image type, and processing status.
Metadata will describe the experimental design, treatment allocation, sampling dates, sampling occasions, replicate tanks, fish-level measurements, tank-level biomass, image filenames, image-processing information, and measurement protocols. Metadata and supporting documentation will be stored as CSV, README, PDF, DOCX, and, where necessary during the working phase, XLSX files.
Data analysis scripts for statistical analyses and image processing will be stored as R (.R) and Python (.py) files.

distribution.available_until: An embargo of up to 12 months, or until publication of the associated manuscript (whichever comes first), will be applied to allow time for data analysis and manuscript preparation. The embargo will be lifted by the corresponding author.

dmp.description: The project generates both raw and processed research data. Raw data include individual fish body weight and total length measurements, tank biomass at each sampling occasion, mortality records, and digital images of individual fish collected at each sampling point for non-invasive image-based identification. Processed data include calculated growth performance parameters such as weight gain (WG), specific growth rate (SGR), condition factor (K), survival rate, and processed region-of-interest images generated from the image-processing workflow. Metadata describing the experimental design, treatment allocation, sampling dates and occasions, replicate tanks, virtual fish identity tags, image filenames, individual measurements, tank biomass records, image-processing steps, quality-control information, and measurement protocols are recorded to ensure data integrity, traceability, and reproducibility.
